video_title: Postgame Media Availability with Coach Daigneault, Shai, and Ajay | OKC Thunder | November 25, 2026

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on balancing winning with long-term team development
quotes.excerpt: we're trying to win every game, but we also are trying to make investments in our season
quotes.quote: We're trying to win every game, obviously. I think the guys are really competing and trying to do that. But we also are trying to make investments in our season, and in the short-term and long-term future of the team given the circumstances. In the past, we've done that. We've planted those seeds and struggled and worked through times like this, and then it yielded future success and positive results. We have to continue to take an optimistic mindset to that, despite the fact that it has been a struggle, it's been challenging.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the Thunder approach during this challenging stretch: We are trying to win every game but also making investments in the short and long term future of the team.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault discusses the team's approach to balancing immediate competitiveness with long-term development during a challenging stretch of the season.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the defensive versatility of Cason Wallace
quotes.excerpt: Cason Wallace is like a five-man defense type player, especially the way they're using him right now
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace is like a five-man defense type player, especially the way they're using him right now. He's guarding some of the best players in the league, and he's going from an assignment like Pascal Siakam, that's like a bigger wing player and slower game, to a guy that's hard to, a slippery player on the perimeter. These are good experiences for him. The thing about him is he's always competing. It's easy to continue to bet on him because you know he's going to compete, and as a result, he's going to improve.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace: He is a five man defense type player. He is guarding some of the best players in the league and it is easy to continue to bet on him because you know he is going to compete.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault praises the defensive versatility and competitive spirit of Cason Wallace while noting his recent assignments.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the importance of executing in close games
quotes.excerpt: we need to execute a few more plays in a game that comes down to one or two possessions
quotes.quote: The common theme is it's a 48-minute game, and we need to execute a few more plays in a game that comes down to one or two possessions in order to be on the other side of the result. That can happen in the second quarter, it can happen in the first quarter, and it can happen late. We just have to fight for those margins right now, improve on the things that we know the game is going to come down to.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says the common theme in recent losses is needing to execute a few more plays in a game that comes down to one or two possessions.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault explains the need for better execution in close games to improve the team's win-loss record.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the team's fluid rotation and bench usage
quotes.excerpt: it's nice having Jared McCain on the bench. We wanted to take a look at something different
quotes.quote: We're small in the second unit with K. Rich at the five right now. A lot of that decision making was about how do we bridge to a smaller lineup with having some bigger wings on the floor. And I also I like coming off the bench at times with Jared McCain. Obviously, he started a lot of games, but him, Caruso, K. Rich, those are guys that they elevate the tone of the game when they go in there on a lot of nights. And so it's nice having them on the bench. We wanted to take a look at something different. We thought it was a good opportunity to do that, but we've been very fluid during this time. We're looking for every edge we can.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the Thunder rotation: We are small in the second unit with K. Rich at the five. We have been very fluid during this time looking for every edge we can.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault discusses his recent rotation adjustments and the impact of using Jared McCain and Alex Caruso off the bench.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the team's need for better attention to detail
quotes.excerpt: we just have to do better in all the little things. Obviously, our margin for error is slimmer
quotes.quote: We just have to do better in all the little things. Obviously, our margin for error is slimmer and slimmer, and that's just the reality. We just have to win those little things and win more of them to get a W.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the current state of the Thunder: Our margin for error is slimmer and slimmer and that is just the reality. We have to win those little things to get a W.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander reflects on the team's need for improved attention to detail in close games.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Cason Wallace's development and effort
quotes.excerpt: he's giving the effort, energy, great team guy. He's figuring out his way in this league
quotes.quote: He's doing everything he could do, which is all you can ask. He's giving the effort, energy, great team guy. He's figuring out his way in this league, and yeah, he'll be good for a long time.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Cason Wallace: He is doing everything he could do. He is figuring out his way in this league and he will be good for a long time.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander comments on the effort and development of his teammate Cason Wallace.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the importance of small details in losses
quotes.excerpt: the margin of error is smaller, so like those little things matter so much more
quotes.quote: The margin of error is smaller, so like those little things matter so much more, whether it's rebounding, whether it's loose balls, whether it's hand discipline and not fouling. Yeah, they become more important.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the focus for OKC: The margin of error is smaller so those little things matter so much more whether it is rebounding or hand discipline and not fouling.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander emphasizes the importance of small details like rebounding and discipline in tight games.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Cason Wallace's growth as a scorer
quotes.excerpt: Cason Wallace is just a hooper. You throw Cason Wallace on any floor in the world
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace is just a hooper. You throw Cason Wallace on any floor in the world, and he'll be productive out there. It doesn't matter who's out there. He loves the game, competes, he gives it the effort, and the game rewards him back. I'm not surprised by anything Cason Wallace does just because I know the energy he has and the work he puts into his game.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Cason Wallace: Cason is just a hooper. You throw him on any floor in the world and he will be productive. I am not surprised by anything he does because I know the energy he has.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on the team learning from close-game losses
quotes.excerpt: it definitely sucks to lose games like that, but I think as a team we get to learn
quotes.quote: It definitely sucks to lose games like that, but I think as a team we get to learn a lot about ourselves. And I mean, we see it comes down to details. I think we give our all every single night, and in those losses we're able to just see what was missing in a couple possessions, areas we can improve. And I think that's great for our team down the line.
quotes.social_post: Ajay Mitchell on the team learning from close losses: It definitely sucks to lose games like that but I think as a team we get to learn a lot about ourselves.

structured.context: Ajay Mitchell discusses the team's ability to learn from recent close-game losses.
